blocks.en: # Recipes and pitfalls
blocks.zh: # 常用做法与易错点

blocks.en: Prompts worth copying, then the mistakes everyone makes once. Swap in your own paths and finish conditions. The recipes are deliberately informal. That's how they get typed in practice, and the skills read intent fine.
blocks.zh: 这里先给出值得借用的提示词，再列出常见错误。把其中路径和完成条件换成自己的即可。示例刻意保留口语风格，因为实际工作中就是这样输入的，skill 能理解其中的意图。

blocks.en: ![She tastes a finished dish while robots cook from a recipe box, with pinned cards reading /how, /tdd, and /loop above the counter.](./images/recipes.jpg)
blocks.zh: ![她品尝做好的菜，机器人按食谱盒中的说明烹饪；操作台上方贴着 /how、/tdd 和 /loop 卡片。](./images/recipes.jpg)

blocks.en: ## Understand an unfamiliar subsystem
blocks.zh: ## 理解陌生子系统

blocks.en:
```text
use /how first to understand how this initialization works. then use /why to figure out why it broke recently.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
先用 /how 理解初始化流程怎么工作，再用 /why 查清它最近为什么出问题。
```

blocks.en: Mechanics first, history second. Each skill's report tells you which sources it searched, so you know what the answer is grounded in.
blocks.zh: 先看机制，再查历史。每个 skill 的报告会列出查过哪些来源，让你知道答案依据什么。

blocks.en: ## Get a second opinion on a design
blocks.zh: ## 为设计寻求独立意见

blocks.en:
```text
ask /arena for a second opinion on this thread and our approach
```
blocks.zh:
```text
请 /arena 对这段讨论和我们的方案给出独立意见
```

blocks.en: Your current design becomes one candidate among several, and the synthesis tells you whether the panel found something better or confirmed what you had. Cheap insurance before a costly commitment.
blocks.zh: 当前设计会成为多个候选之一。综合结果会告诉你，模型组是找到更好的方案，还是验证了现有方案。可以在做出高成本承诺之前，用较低成本降低风险。

blocks.en: ## Check independent slices in parallel
blocks.zh: ## 并行检查独立范围

blocks.en:
```text
/swarm check every package under packages/ against its check.sh. one worker per package. one report.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
/swarm 按各自的 check.sh 检查 packages/ 下的每个包。每个包一个 worker，最终给我一份报告。
```

blocks.en: Each worker owns one package. The parent waits for every slice and returns one `PASS`, `ISSUES`, or `BLOCKED` report instead of raw worker dumps.
blocks.zh: 每个 worker 负责一个包。主 agent 等待所有范围完成后，给出一份 `PASS`、`ISSUES` 或 `BLOCKED` 报告，而不是直接倾倒 worker 的原始输出。

blocks.en: ## Review a branch skeptically
blocks.zh: ## 带着怀疑审查分支

blocks.en:
```text
/interrogate the whole branch, but skeptically. don't change anything yet. no nitpicks unless it's an actual bug or regression in behavior.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
/interrogate 带着怀疑审查整个分支。暂时不要修改。只报告实际 bug 或行为回归，不要挑无关紧要的小毛病。
```

blocks.en: The qualifiers do real work. "don't change anything yet" keeps it read-only, and the nitpick rule pre-filters the noise so `Act on` findings are worth your time.
blocks.zh: 这些限定语有实际作用。“暂时不要修改”保证只读，“不要挑小毛病”提前过滤噪声，让 `Act on` 中的问题值得你投入时间。

blocks.en: ## Fix a bug through a failing test
blocks.zh: ## 通过失败测试修复 bug

blocks.en:
```text
/poteto-mode repro the duplicate write first. if there's a cheap test path, /tdd it. then fix and rerun.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
/poteto-mode 先复现重复写入。如果有低成本测试路径，就用 /tdd。再修复并重跑。
```

blocks.en: "if there's a cheap test path" matters. Forcing a test through brittle mocks proves less than running the real command, and the playbook is allowed to say so.
blocks.zh: “如果有低成本测试路径”很重要。用脆弱 mock 强行搭出测试，证据力度可能不如直接运行真实命令，执行规程允许明确指出这一点。

blocks.en: ## Keep a run honest while you're away
blocks.zh: ## 离开时仍让执行过程有据可查

blocks.en:
```text
im going to bed, keep going autonomously until every fixture passes. do not stop. keep a decision log i can audit in the morning.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
我要睡了。自主持续执行，直到所有测试样本通过。不要停止。保留决策记录，供我明早复核。
```

blocks.en: The full contract is on the [overnight page](./07-overnight.md). The short form works once the task and finish condition are already in the conversation.
blocks.zh: 完整约定见[夜间执行页面](./07-overnight.md)。对话已经包含任务和完成条件后，可以使用这个简短版本。

blocks.en: ## Redirect a drifting run
blocks.zh: ## 纠正偏离目标的执行

blocks.en: Steering prompts are one line:
blocks.zh: 调整方向只需要一句话：

blocks.en:
```text
i said the goal is to repro. i did not ask for a fix yet.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
我说的目标是复现，还没有要求修复。
```

blocks.en:
```text
apply prove it works. show me the real output, not the build log.
```
blocks.zh:
```text
应用 prove it works 原则。给我看真实输出，不是构建日志。
```

blocks.en:
```text
/unslop that, no emdashes
```
blocks.zh:
```text
/unslop 整理这段，不要用破折号
```

blocks.en: You rarely need more words. You need the right name, and [the principles page](./08-principles.md) is the vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 通常不需要更多文字，需要的是准确的名称。[原则页面](./08-principles.md) 提供这套表达。

blocks.en: ## Get the reply in plain words
blocks.zh: ## 让回复使用普通语言

blocks.en:
```text
/bro
```
blocks.zh:
```text
/bro
```

blocks.en: That's the whole prompt. [`/bro`](../../skills/bro/SKILL.md) restates the last message like one human talking to another, no jargon, shorter. Use it when a reply is technically thorough and you still don't know what it said.
blocks.zh: 整个提示词就这一条。[`/bro`](../../skills/bro/SKILL.md) 会把上一条消息改写得像人与人之间的交流，减少术语、缩短篇幅。如果回复技术上很完整，但你还是没理解它说什么，可以用它。

blocks.en: ## The pitfalls
blocks.zh: ## 常见易错点

blocks.en:
- **Enumerating skills in the prompt.** "use /how then /architect then /arena" reorders steps the playbook already sequences. State the goal and constraints. Name a skill only to override a default.
- **A vague finish condition.** "make it better" gives `/loop` nothing to check. Give a command or artifact that can pass or fail.
- **Parallel agents in one worktree.** They overwrite each other and the diff becomes archaeology. Say "own worktree per attempt" and the isolation is free.
- **Using `/arena` for coverage.** `/arena` repeats one design or code brief, then picks a base and grafts the best parts. `/swarm` partitions slices or declared race arms and aggregates one report.
- **Accepting every review comment.** Bots and humans both file real catches and noise in one list. `/interrogate` sorts findings into act-on and dismissed buckets with reasons, and you can override either way.
- **Treating `auto` as a model slug.** `auto` and `inherit-parent` mean "omit the model field so the subagent inherits the parent chat model." [Setup](./01-setup.md) covers the roles.
- **Reporting success off a green build.** A build proves it compiles. Ask for the real command, flow, stored value, or profile, and expect the evidence in the reply.
- **Writing a `SKILL.md` freehand.** Route it through the [Authoring or modifying a skill playbook](../../skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/authoring-a-skill.md) so validation and review happen.
blocks.zh:
- 在提示词中逐项安排 skill。“先 /how，再 /architect，然后 /arena”会重新排列执行规程已有的步骤。说明目标和约束即可，只有覆盖默认选择时才指定 skill。
- 完成条件模糊。“把它做好些”没有给 `/loop` 可检验的条件。给出能明确通过或失败的命令或产物。
- 并行 agent 共用一个 worktree。它们会覆盖彼此的改动，最后只能从 diff 中艰难追溯。要求“每个尝试独立 worktree”就能获得隔离。
- 用 `/arena` 扩大检查覆盖。`/arena` 重复处理同一份设计或代码任务，再选择基础方案并综合长处。`/swarm` 才负责分配不同范围或预先声明的竞赛候选，再汇总报告。
- 接受每条评审意见。bot 和人都会把真实问题与噪声放在同一份列表里。`/interrogate` 会分类需要处理和被驳回的发现，并说明理由；你可以推翻任一判断。
- 把 `auto` 当模型标识。`auto` 和 `inherit-parent` 都表示“省略 model 字段，让 subagent 继承主对话模型”。[配置页面](./01-setup.md) 说明了角色设置。
- 仅凭构建通过就报告成功。构建只能证明能编译。应要求运行真实命令、操作流程、读取存储值或采集性能分析，并在回复中展示证据。
- 随手编写 `SKILL.md`。通过 [Authoring or modifying a skill 执行规程](../../skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/authoring-a-skill.md) 处理，保证经过校验与评审。

blocks.en: That's the guide. If you skipped ahead, go back to [setup](./01-setup.md) and run one real task. The habits stick from use, not from reading.
blocks.zh: 指南到这里结束。如果你跳着读，回到[配置页面](./01-setup.md)，执行一个真实任务。工作习惯靠实践形成，不是只靠阅读。
